Frontend Admin (verified DOM via Playwright): (a) Eventi form has both data-testid=upload-event-poster and upload-event-artist upload buttons with URL input fallback; (b) Media tab renders data-testid=media-category-filter with 7 options ['', gallery-eventi, gallery-location, gallery-dettagli, event-poster, event-artist, assets], and when gallery-eventi selected shows 4 tiles each with media-up-{id}, media-down-{id}, and media-cat-{id} selectors; (c) Contenuti tab has data-testid=content-gallery-preview-kicker and content-gallery-preview-title (current value 'Uno sguardo dentro'). Home /: [data-testid=home-gallery-preview] renders with heading 'UNO SGUARDO DENTRO' (uppercased via CSS), kicker 'EVENTI' fallback (kicker setting empty → uses first gallery group title), and 4 home-gallery-item tiles. All previously-working functionality intact.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. The rendered <option> wraps its title in a Fast-Refresh runtime <span> for editable-source tracing, which browsers reject. This is a dev-only issue caused by the emergent dev overlay wrapping dynamic text; harmless in production build. Optional: set the option label via {String(g.title)} or plain text to sidestep the wrapper. Not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: list_media still uses strict {is_deleted: False} filter (server.py:930). Prior iteration flagged this — legacy/seeded rows missing the field are silently dropped. Consider {'is_deleted': {'$ne': True}}.
PATCH /admin/media/{id} only accepts category/caption but not event_id — if admin ever needs to reassociate a media to another event, another patchable field would be needed.

reorder_media does not validate that ids belong to the same category — the frontend calls it with the currently filtered list, but a malicious/incorrect payload could reorder across categories. Minor since it's admin-only.
